assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only 86-eighty-six:shiden-iida@original-light-novels#86-shiden-iida-character-reference-profile, the canonical CMR-4 Shiden Iida character reference profile (version 1.2, release 86-V2-V01-V14-1.0) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the locked original-Japanese light novels V01-V14, in which she is attested from V02, with Alter.1 as audited supplemental ordinary-life evidence and Alter.2 excluded. The project's Character Modeling Reference method (its purpose and Japanese-voice sections) was read for method and authority order only. The CMR-9 profile gate audit row and the profile's validation report are not curated evidence on this subject, and no count, version or verdict is taken from them. The ledgers L01, L02 and L09, Documents 04 and 09, the relationship matrix, the diagnostic index, the Phase-5 and Phase-8 artifacts and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject, and nothing is borrowed from them. The profile's CMR-9 status and its HIGH, MODERATE and OPEN labels are inputs, not conclusions. No anime adaptation, V15+ volume, Alter.2 scene or other character's profile is included, and the evaluator inspected no primary source.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The profile's state map from V02-V03 (field voice already present, four rows) through V14 (social-system perception under final-arc pressure). V07 is split at the pivot from teasing to concern (p-008 ¶58-67) and the confrontation, self-disclosure and name shift (¶87-123; p-009 ¶277). V09 is split at the concrete grief after Shana's death (p-004 ¶58-73), the exclusive claim and its correction by Shin (Shinei Nouzen) (p-006 ¶343-383), the death wish and help-seeking with Olivia (p-008 ¶524-583), the revision and farewell (¶599-608) and the stated wish for the war to end and an easy, enjoyable life (p-011 ¶558-566). Other volumes are single-volume states. No default state is set; one must be selected. V01 does not attest her, Alter.1 rows are ordinary-life supplements without volume placement, and states after V14 are not established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The profile gives a causal account of Shiden (Shiden Iida): roughness is a register and a social strategy, not a hostility meter; loyalty gives her a right to contradict (pinning down and confronting Lena (Vladilena Milizé), V07 p-008 ¶87-99); and her care is intervention without sanctimony. It states what changes her response: whether a teasing target stays reciprocal (tease, watch, continue or pivot, V07 p-008 ¶58-67); the listed intervention thresholds (a self-endangering commander, a grief-impaired fighter, an overresponsible person, a direct tactical threat, information not reaching people, political contempt becoming a threat); whether a correction rests on a rule she holds (V09 p-006 ¶363); and whether she has the standing to receive someone's weakness (V14 p-004 ¶418-427). It predicts her mistakes: grief turning decisiveness into an exclusive claim and risk tolerance into death-seeking (V09 p-006 ¶343-351; p-008 ¶524-561), viciousness toward Republic civilians (V11 p-016 ¶40), and a susceptibility to propaganda she later recognizes (V11 p-012 ¶37; V13 p-005 ¶17). A would overclaim: the set is one derived artifact that defers to L01, L02 and L09 outside it, the grief failure mode rests on one loss, both romantic statuses are OPEN, and the final-arc state is unavailable. C would understate an account that discriminates reciprocity, standing, rule legitimacy and grief and predicts her errors with their corrections.

The profile gives an ordered state map for Shiden (Shiden Iida) with located anchors: V02-V03 field voice under Lena (Vladilena Milizé) (V02 p-002 ¶23; V03 p-013 ¶11-47); V04 independent commander and the rivalry with Shin (Shinei Nouzen), including accepting a loss (p-006 ¶213-288); V05 a nonpossessive attitude to Lena's romance (p-004 ¶619); V06 excluding the impaired Shin (p-005 ¶622); V07 confrontation, self-disclosure and the レーナ shift (p-008 ¶87-123; p-009 ¶277-281); V08 restoring Lena's command function (p-011 ¶54-64); the V09 grief sequence through death-seeking to the wish for an easy, enjoyable life (p-004 ¶58-73; p-006 ¶343-383; p-008 ¶524-608; p-011 ¶558-566); V10 preserving Shin's pistol (p-009 ¶15-21); V11 contempt under restraint (p-016 ¶28-43); V12 bounded responsibility and learning (p-005 ¶426-571; p-008 ¶469); V13 political self-critique (p-005 ¶17); and V14 support routing (p-004 ¶418-427). It forbids reading the V09 death wish as her true self or battlefield joy as a wish for endless war. C would understate a located, causally ordered map with these controls. A is rejected: outside V07 and V09 each volume is one state, V02-V03 have four rows, the V13 entry rests on seven rows, no default is named, and nothing after V14 is established.

The profile gives a functional Japanese fingerprint for Shiden (Shiden Iida): stable あたし, not normalized to 私 in serious scenes; rough colloquial tendencies (～ねえ, ～じゃねえ, ～だぜ, ～すんな, clipped questions, direct imperatives, profanity under anger); address as a relationship diagnostic (死神ちゃん, 色男, お前 and mock-formal ノウゼン大尉殿 for Shin (Shinei Nouzen); 女王陛下 and the marked レーナ for Lena (Vladilena Milizé), V07 p-008 ¶123, p-009 ¶277; ちびっこ for Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort)); the distinction between sarcastic mock-politeness (ハイハイそうですねー…, V09 p-006 ¶383) and genuine institutional politeness (中佐殿、すんません。ちょっと質問いいすか and ありがとうございます to Miarlona, V12 p-005 ¶553, ¶571); compressed tactical command (了解, V14 p-004 ¶432); and grief that lowers and simplifies her speech (V09 p-004 ¶64-73). A state table says what changes and what stays, and many of the 38 would-sound-wrong constraints concern form. For illustrative textual Japanese with sampled interlocutors in sampled states, C would understate it. A is rejected: the morphology is listed as tendencies without frequency; exemplars are not classified by focalization; few voice exemplars carry an inline locator; there is no address form for Raiden (Raiden Shuga), Shana or Brísingamen subordinates; and the L09 voice ledger is outside the set.

The profile gives Shiden (Shiden Iida) broad ordinary texture: a luxury bed she worries will make her soft (V05 p-004 ¶605); knowing court etiquette without accepting its authority (V05 p-005 ¶204); bodily ease at the bath and in clothing (V07 p-006 ¶23; Alter.1 part0030 ¶21); dancing (V07 p-009 ¶269-271); meals with Brísingamen (V11 p-018 ¶390); games and play (V13 p-005 ¶256-265; Alter.1 part0041 ¶5, part0062 ¶239-261); gifts (Alter.1 part0053 ¶21; part0055 ¶25); science curiosity that ends in 'not for me' (V12 p-005 ¶545-561; p-008 ¶469); and scavenged equipment (V14 p-004 ¶389-393). It names her pleasures as social, physical and immediate, and 気楽に楽しく (V09 p-011 ¶566) as the ordinary-life anchor. B would overclaim: section VIII is a list, several items (museums, drinking tea badly on purpose, the formal tie, underwear jokes) carry no row, there is no routine, sequence or frequency, and outside teasing and learning the profile does not say what decides her ordinary choices. D would understate recurring located ordinary conduct from V05 to V14 and Alter.1 with a stated character of pleasure.

Nine directed relations from Shiden (Shiden Iida) are analyzed and distinguished: Lena (Vladilena Milizé), under 女王陛下 loyalty with corrective standing (V06 p-006 ¶676; V07 p-008 ¶87-99; V08 p-011 ¶54-64) and nonpossessive attraction (V05 p-004 ¶619; V07 p-009 ¶281); Shin (Shinei Nouzen), as a rival with tacit limits (V08 p-004 ¶218-223), reciprocal safety correction (V06 p-005 ¶622; V09 p-006 ¶363) and material care (V10 p-009 ¶15-21); Shana, a four-year comrade whose death drives the V09 crisis; Brísingamen as an independent command home; Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort), under irreverent older-sister correction (V12 p-005 ¶426-438); Republic civilians, held in contempt but protected (V11 p-016 ¶28-43); Miarlona, in genuine institutional politeness (V12 p-005 ¶553-571); Raiden (Raiden Shuga), whose weakness she knows she may lack the standing to receive (V14 p-004 ¶418-427); and Olivia, a chosen adult audience (V09 p-008 ¶574-583). C would understate this partner-specific discrimination. A is rejected: Shana alive rests on three V05 rows; Brísingamen members are not individuated; Raiden, Olivia and Miarlona rest on a few rows each; both romantic statuses are OPEN; and the relationship matrix and L02 are outside the set.

The private states of Shiden (Shiden Iida) are rendered densely in V09: grief fixed on concrete detail (p-004 ¶58-73), active bodily self-regulation (p-006 ¶379), the death wish and the recognition that battlefield life had stood in for a future (p-008 ¶524-561), and the choice of Olivia as audience because the question feels too shameful for Shin (Shinei Nouzen) (¶574-583). Outside V09 the profile locates her own fear while steadying Lena (Vladilena Milizé) (V08 p-011 ¶58), her recognition of past susceptibility to propaganda (V13 p-005 ¶17) and her reasoning about who could reach Raiden (Raiden Shuga) (V14 p-004 ¶418-427). D would understate this: the V09 sequence is causally tied to her claim, correction, help-seeking and revision. B would overclaim: across V04-V08 and V10-V12 her states are mostly inferred from conduct rather than rendered, her V07 self-disclosure is spoken to Lena, exemplars are not classified by focalization, and the profile offers no account of her interior outside grief and support routing.

The profile states the conflict sequence of Shiden (Shiden Iida) (name the problem, challenge the hidden premise, use concrete personal or operational evidence, demand a decision or correction, then return to the ordinary relation) and its classes: physical rivalry she can lose and accept (V04 p-006 ¶213-288); loyal opposition to a self-endangering or self-excluding commander (V06 p-006 ¶676; V07 p-008 ¶87-99; V08 p-011 ¶54); excluding an impaired comrade (V06 p-005 ¶622) and accepting the same exclusion (V09 p-006 ¶363); resisting paternalistic information control while grieving (p-006 ¶348); and contempt for Republic civilians bounded short of killing (V04 p-009 ¶218-228; V11 p-016 ¶28-43). It names her unfairness while grieving and her viciousness. C would understate conditioned response families with located boundaries. A is rejected: the death-seeking state is sampled once, conflict with senior officers beyond Vika (Viktor Idinarohk) and Miarlona is unsampled, and the final-arc state is unavailable.

The profile locates argued positions for Shiden (Shiden Iida) and a concrete, anti-grandiose reasoning style: self-direction that grants others the same right (V05 p-005 ¶249-251); additive identity against the self-reduction of Lena (Vladilena Milizé), argued from her own eyes and dead sister (V07 p-008 ¶96-120); reciprocal safety rules (V06 p-005 ¶622; V09 p-006 ¶363); bounded responsibility for Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort) (V12 p-005 ¶430-438); protection without forgiveness (V11 p-016 ¶43); memory without following the dead (V09 p-008 ¶599-608); and self-critique about propaganda (V13 p-005 ¶17). It predicts failures: death-seeking presented as loyalty to Shana, dehumanizing contempt and unfairness under grief. C would understate located positions with a reasoning style and failure modes. A is rejected: her final political judgment is unavailable, the V09 weighing of loyalty to the dead against the living rests on one loss, and her views on the war's end beyond the wish for an easy life are not modeled.

The profile gives the humor of Shiden (Shiden Iida) a function and a stop rule: high-contact forms (nicknames, sexual teasing, deliberately bad suggestions, physical comedy, mock-formal sarcasm, exaggerated laughter, competitive ribbing), continued only while the target stays reciprocal and dropped when a state is wrong (V07 p-008 ¶58-67; Alter.1 part0037 ¶50). Sarcasm marks the return of her ordinary self after correction (V09 p-006 ¶383; p-011 ¶540), humor survives the final arc (V14 p-004 ¶382-412), and she can lose a game without a status crisis (Alter.1 part0062 ¶261). C would understate a located functional account with a suspension condition. A is rejected: the sexual-teasing boundary rests mainly on V07 and Alter.1, the profile notes that the corpus gives no account of consent in her own words, and many humor rows are Alter.1 without volume placement.

A dedicated canonical profile of Shiden (Shiden Iida) over V02-V14 with Alter.1 supplemental and 173 routed diagnostic rows with EPUB paragraph routes, 164 in V02-V14 and 9 in Alter.1; the profile does not mark which rows also carry a frozen Phase-5 locator. V02 and V03 have one and three rows and V13 seven, while V09 has 28 and V04 26. B would overclaim: this is a derived compression across thirteen volumes; the narrower authorities that control conflicts (L01, L02, L09, Documents 04 and 09, the relationship matrix and the diagnostic index) are outside the set; the scene-bank rows give a state tag and a gloss but not the event, so events are recoverable only from the prose sections; and the profile has no counterexample audit or bounded-prediction section. D would understate dedicated coverage that reaches every volume in which she appears with exact routes.

There are 30 mischaracterization traps and 38 would-sound-wrong constraints for Shiden (Shiden Iida), each with a stated basis: 'rough speech means hostility' and 'she cannot speak politely' fall to the Miarlona scene (V12 p-005 ¶553, ¶571); 'sexual jokes mean she ignores distress' falls to the V07 pivot (p-008 ¶67); 'always emotionally tougher than the Five' and 'death-seeking is her true self' fall to V09 (p-008 ¶524-608); 'contempt means she wants to kill them all' and 'protection means forgiveness' fall to V04 and V11 (p-009 ¶228; p-016 ¶34-43); 'if she sees a problem she fixes it herself' falls to the V14 support routing (p-004 ¶423-427); and 'using レーナ proves a canonical romance' and 'Shana's death proves romance' are bounded by the OPEN entries. C would understate these affirmative, located constraints. A is rejected: there is no dispositioned counterexample audit, many traps are profile rules without their own row, and limits after V14 are open.

Each diagnostic row for Shiden (Shiden Iida) is located by volume, XHTML file and paragraph, and the two volumes that carry her main state changes are split inside themselves: V07 teasing (p-008 ¶57-58), the pivot to concern (¶67), the confrontation and self-disclosure (¶87-120) and the name shift (¶123; p-009 ¶277); and V09 concrete grief (p-004), the claim and its correction (p-006 ¶343-383), the death wish and help-seeking (p-008 ¶524-583), the revision (¶599-608) and the future wish (p-011 ¶558-566). C would understate this. A is rejected: the other volumes are single entries in the state map, the profile names no default state (this record requires one to be selected), V02-V03 and V13 are thinly sampled, and the nine Alter.1 rows are not placed by volume.

conditions: Illustrative textual Japanese only, never quotation, with あたし as first person in every state and rough colloquial morphology treated as tendencies, not a phrase generator; caring never softens her into polite warmth.

Address uses only attested forms: 死神ちゃん, 色男, お前 or mock-formal ノウゼン大尉殿 for Shin (Shinei Nouzen) by state; 女王陛下 for Lena (Vladilena Milizé), with レーナ as a marked intimate shift that does not retire the title; ちびっこ for Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort); and 中佐殿 with polite forms for Miarlona. No form for Raiden (Raiden Shuga), Shana or other people is invented.
Mock-politeness after a correction and genuine institutional politeness are kept distinct; tactical command is compressed; grief is quieter, repetitive and concrete without changing the speaker.
No frequency claim, anime voice performance (the hoarse alto is narrated perception only) or state after V14.
scenario_readiness.note: The evidence supports constrained illustrative output with sampled interlocutors in sampled states. Missing frequency and focalization data restrict form, not use.

conditions: Chronology is one explicitly selected named state; there is no default. The states are: V02-V03 field voice; V04 rival and newly arrived commander; V05 court interlude; V06 restriction of the impaired Shin (Shinei Nouzen); V07 before or after the pivot and confrontation (p-008 ¶67, ¶87-123); V08 command regulator; V09 acute grief, death-seeking, help-seeking or after the revision (p-008 ¶599-608; p-011 ¶558-566); or one of V10, V11, V12, V13 and V14. Nothing after V14 is used, V01 does not attest her, and Alter.1 rows never fix a state.

The interlocutor is a profiled relation in its attested register: Lena (Vladilena Milizé), Shin, Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort), Brísingamen, Republic civilians, Miarlona or Olivia. Raiden (Raiden Shuga), Vika (Viktor Idinarohk), Theo (Theoto Rikka), Fido and Shana (in memory after V09) are used only within their sampled rows. Transfer to a comparable peer is a separate, lower-confidence condition justified by the Shin and Lena patterns.

The situation matches a sampled class: teasing that may stop landing, a commander or comrade endangering themselves, a fighter impaired by injury or grief, an overresponsible person, Republic contempt becoming a threat, admitted ignorance before an expert, a friend needing support she may not be able to give, ordinary play and leisure, or close-range command.

Output predicts her characteristic errors (exclusive claims and death-seeking under acute grief, dehumanizing contempt, unfairness while grieving) together with her located corrigibility, and never upgrades her attraction to Lena or her attachment to Shana into a romantic relationship.

It abstains on both romantic statuses, a postwar vocation, family dynamics beyond the attested scenes, and her final-arc political and relational state; it introduces no institution, technology or relationship state absent from V02-V14.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One explicitly selected V02-V14 state, with V07 split at p-008 ¶67 and ¶87-123 and V09 split at p-004, p-006 ¶343-383, p-008 ¶524-583, p-008 ¶599-608 and p-011 ¶558-566. No default, no state after V14, and no chronological use of Alter.1.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Lena (Vladilena Milizé), Shin (Shinei Nouzen), Frederica (Frederica Rosenfort), Brísingamen, Republic civilians, Miarlona or Olivia in their attested registers; Raiden (Raiden Shuga), Vika (Viktor Idinarohk), Theo (Theoto Rikka), Fido and the remembered Shana only within their sampled rows. A comparable peer is a separate, lower-confidence transfer, and unsampled senior officers are excluded.
setting_constraints: Republic, Federacy and allied military operations, base life, court and formal events, leisure, parties, games and study within V02-V14, or Alter.1 ordinary life without volume placement
No postwar career, romantic relationship, formal political office or Alter.2 setting
No institution, technology or culture absent from the V02-V14 corpus

scenario_readiness.note: Bounded to sampled relations, situation classes and one explicitly selected state at the located turns. Romance, postwar life and relations outside the sampled rows are excluded rather than inferred.

conditions: Sampled ordinary classes only: rest and material comfort, court and formal events, bathing and clothing, dancing, meals with her squadron, games and physical play, gifts and birthdays, news and political talk, learning from an expert, and inspecting equipment.
Teasing follows the reciprocity rule; her pleasures are social, physical and immediate, and curiosity may end in 'not for me'.
No invented routine, named tastes beyond those attested, or settled civilian occupation.
scenario_readiness.note: Recurring located ordinary conduct with a reciprocity rule supports more than NOT_READY. The list-like ordinary account, unlocated items and the absence of routine block READY.

conditions: Situation classes the profile samples: self-exclusion or self-endangering by someone she is loyal to, a grief-impaired fighter, overresponsibility, contempt set against protection of Republic civilians, loyalty to the dead set against the living, and manipulation by propaganda.
Reasoning uses concrete personal or operational evidence in plain language, not abstract philosophy.
The model must allow her located failure modes: exclusive claims and death-seeking under acute grief, and vicious contempt.
No final political judgment, forgiveness of the Republic, or novel competing-duty weighing outside these classes.
scenario_readiness.note: Located argued positions with a stated reasoning style and failure modes support bounded ethical extrapolation within the sampled classes.

Both romantic relations available to Shiden (Shiden Iida) are explicitly unresolved in the evidence: the attraction to Lena (Vladilena Milizé) is strong implication with no confession or relationship (V07 p-009 ¶281) and is held nonpossessively (V05 p-004 ¶619), and the attachment to Shana is OPEN and unsupported as a romantic claim. Any romance scenario would have to decide what the profile leaves open. Her conduct around the romance of Lena and Shin (Shinei Nouzen) belongs to relationship and mundane-social use, not to this scenario. This limits use; it is not a finding about the character.

conditions: The selected state fixes the role: Brísingamen commander with sensor, communications and close-suppression competence (V04 p-007 ¶127-131; V06 p-006 ¶598; V14 p-004 ¶432-433; p-008 ¶310); restorer of the command function of Lena (Vladilena Milizé) (V08 p-011 ¶54-64); the commander who excludes an impaired comrade (V06 p-005 ¶622); the grief-impaired fighter correctly excluded (V09 p-006 ¶363); or the crisis communicator (V13 p-007 ¶972; V14 p-006 ¶215).
Banter stops and command compresses at once; aggressive initiative stays inside recognized command; polite institutional register appears with a senior officer when the context calls for it.
No exchange with senior officers beyond the sampled rows and no postwar career.
scenario_readiness.note: Sampled conduct in each professional state, including her own correct exclusion, supports bounded extrapolation within one selected state.

known_limits.statement: Through V14 and Alter.1 the profile records strong romantic implication from Shiden (Shiden Iida) toward Lena (Vladilena Milizé) with no confession or relationship, and extraordinary attachment to Shana that is OPEN and unsupported as a romantic claim. Neither may be upgraded or erased.

The source boundary is locked original-Japanese V01-V14, with Shiden (Shiden Iida) attested from V02, Alter.1 supplemental and Alter.2 excluded. Her postwar vocation, further family history and final political, military and relational state are not established; the wish to live easily and enjoyably is a direction, not an outcome.

The V09 death-seeking state of Shiden (Shiden Iida) (p-008 ¶524-561) is an acute grief state that she recognizes and revises (¶599-608), corrected through a rule she holds (p-006 ¶363). It is not generalized to every loss, and the profile does not establish how she would respond to another catastrophic loss.

The scene-bank rows for Shiden (Shiden Iida) give a state tag, a target and a gloss but not the event, and the profile has no counterexample audit or bounded-prediction section; events are recoverable only from the prose sections.
Outside V09 and the V14 support-routing reasoning, the profile renders little of the interior of Shiden (Shiden Iida); her private states in teasing, rivalry and command are inferred from conduct.

The profile of Shiden (Shiden Iida) is a derived reconstruction reference whose header subordinates it to the Japanese source and the narrower canonical V2 authorities (L01, L02, L09 and the thematic homes), none of which is curated on this row. Its 173 scene-bank rows give EPUB paragraph routes; the profile states that Phase-5 IDs remain coordinate authority where present and that LOCATOR_GAP passages have no frozen Phase-5 locator, without marking which rows are which.
There is no anime, acoustic or performed-voice evidence. Voice claims cover written Japanese only; the narrated hoarse alto is perception, not performance.
